issues.title: Early B205/B235 sludge and chain diagnosis
issues.cause: Multiple sludge/chain-noise causes.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Measure pressure; inspect strainer and bearings as indicated. Tensioner extension over 15 mm requires chain work.
issues.correction_summary: Clean oil system, repair measured damage, fit ventilation kit and specified oil.
limits: Symptom-led procedure; PCV update does not certify prior damage absent.

issues.title: 2004–05 B235 manual oil-trap correction
issues.cause: Revised ventilation can increase oil consumption at high rpm/low load.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm campaign involvement; not every VIN in range qualifies.
issues.correction_summary: Fit oil trap 55558696; specified early engine numbers also need hose 5961610; secure hoses.
limits: Market list not retrieved.
Additional hose applies to engine numbers 4000000–4017590.

issues.title: 2004–05 ventilation hose retention
issues.cause: Hose can detach from throttle body at certain loads.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Check CSP15435 completion and hose retention.
issues.correction_summary: Fit clip 90490543 and cable tie 7971864.
limits: Not every car in VIN interval affected.

issues.title: T7 IDM overload recall15021
issues.cause: Electrical overload can fail the ignition module.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect module serial: D000000–D336210 or B083821–B096117.
issues.correction_summary: Replace affected module with specified T7 unit; other serials are not replaced under this MI.
limits: Also covers 9400 B205/B235 and separate B308 population; does not cover 9440 B207.
Verify actual VIN/recall completion.
Factory source also covers a separately restricted B308 9-5 application; this record retains only the four-cylinder groups.

issues.title: Early 9440 automatic cooler coupling campaign
issues.cause: Quick-coupling O-ring can move and be damaged during fitting, admitting coolant to ATF.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Check CSP15446 and radiator date; replace couplings only if radiator predates 2003-11-08.
issues.correction_summary: Install kit 93190331 per MI.
limits: Campaign VIN limits are narrower than TA440-0702.
Radiator replacement history matters.

issues.title: 2003–05 coolant-contaminated FA57 ATF diagnosis
issues.cause: Insufficient sealing at oil-cooler nipples.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Test ATF for coolant; symptoms alone are insufficient.
issues.correction_summary: Confirmed contamination calls for complete transmission replacement plus coupling repair, cooler/hose cleaning and fresh TCM adaptation.
limits: This is technical advice, not a recall expansion.
TiD limit 51000001 is outside B207 scope.
Especially relevant to avoiding transmission replacement.

issues.title: Early CIM remote software defect
issues.cause: CIM software defect.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Distinguish all-remotes condition.
issues.correction_summary: Update CIM software.

issues.title: Early remote/key acceptance correction
issues.cause: Faulty key/remote.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Follow item3 diagnostics.
issues.correction_summary: Replace faulty remote.
limits: Do not infer every no-start requires CIM.

issues.title: Early ISM key detector sticks
issues.cause: Material defect prevents key detector rising.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Check detector operation.
issues.correction_summary: Replace defective ISM.

issues.title: Start blocking and steering-lock message diagnosis
issues.cause: Low prior-cycle voltage is a leading documented cause; grounds/wiring may contribute.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Record/clear/recheck DTCs; use Tech2 blocking reasons and updated WIS. Test battery/connections/charging and parked current draw.
issues.correction_summary: Correct diagnosed voltage/wiring fault; recharge below 80% SOC.
limits: Returned replacement modules frequently had no fault; diagnose before replacement.
No accessory wiring between CIM, ISM and SCL.

issues.title: B207 cold compression loss from intake-valve wear
issues.cause: Accelerated valve seat-face wear causes cold compression loss.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Overnight-cold compression and leak-down testing; hot testing can miss concern.
issues.correction_summary: TAC-directed repair; advisory lists eight 55563529 intake valves.
limits: 2007–08 coverage explicitly B207R; 2009–11 update says B207.
B284 excluded; 2011 NG9-5 A20NFT also included.
40,000 miles is descriptive, not a failure threshold or prevalence estimate.
No head interchange permission established.

issues.title: B207 unexplained coolant loss / suspected casting porosity
issues.cause: Engineering suspects block casting porosity; investigate other causes first.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Dye/pressure test and track loss; exclude radiator-to-ATF leakage, trapped machining debris, head gasket/head defects.
issues.correction_summary: Short block may require replacement if documented loss remains unexplained; TAC authorization specified.
limits: CV coverage starts 2004.
Reinforced-block boundary: CV suffix66007190; sedan/combi61111931. Later castings reduce likelihood, not eliminate it.
Source boundary wording is inconsistent; no automated safe/unsafe VIN decision is supported. See corrections-gap records.

issues.title: B207 PCV check valve before turbo diagnosis
issues.cause: Intake-manifold check-valve fault can be mistaken for turbo-related oil consumption.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Pressure-test valve before replacing turbo.
issues.correction_summary: Replace failed valve 55557180 with manifold gasket; model-specific removal methods.
limits: 2003–04 explicitly B207R; 2005 onward B207.
Do not transfer B205/B235 PCV6 kit to B207.

issues.title: Front spring corrosion / fracture special coverage15917
issues.cause: Gravel at lower seat damages coating and promotes corrosion.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect both springs for fracture.
issues.correction_summary: Replace both springs using EPC selection and fit two 12794486 zinc plates; omit protective hose.
limits: Historical coverage limited to 10 years/120,000 miles; not current free-repair assurance.
Special coverage, not represented here as a safety recall.

issues.title: Right-side carpet water ingress at A-pillar seam
issues.cause: Poor seam sealant where firewall, RH A-pillar and fender meet.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect engine-bay rear-right corner and interior A-pillar seam.
issues.correction_summary: Remove bad sealant, clean and reseal.
limits: Bulletin gives platform scope without narrower production limits.
It does not establish BCM failure or pollen-filter housing as this cause.

issues.title: Takata driver-inflator recall16V-063 report scope
issues.cause: Inflator rupture can send fragments through cushion.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use VIN-specific involvement and completion record.
issues.correction_summary: VIN-specific replacement of affected driver inflator/module under the applicable campaign; the report is not a parts interchange approval.
limits: This report lists 9-3 MY2003–11 and NG9-5 MY2010–11.
The separate15043 implementation bulletin has different model/year and registration-history restrictions.
VIN-specific involvement and completion still need current verification.

issues.title: 2010–11 original-equipment fuel-pump recall15029 /11V015
issues.cause: Incorrect internal specifications can seize pump.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Verify VIN involvement; affected production June–October2010.
issues.correction_summary: Replace defective pump under campaign.
limits: Not all 2010–11 cars affected; pump number/serial checks not retrieved.

issues.title: Early sedan front-belt ATS cable recall15017 /04V226
issues.cause: Manufacturing damage can break retractor wire.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Verify recall history.
issues.correction_summary: Replace both front belts per campaign.
limits: Excerpt-only source.

issues.title: Later 2004 sedan driver-belt recall10V043
issues.cause: ATS cable can break with time.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm VIN involvement.
issues.correction_summary: Replace driver retractor; passenger side had separate 10-year coverage.
limits: Excerpt-only; detailed VIN boundaries not retrieved.
Passenger coverage is historical.

issues.title: 15043-03 driver-airbag replacement implementation
issues.cause: The bulletin describes driver inflators that can rupture on deployment.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm VIN involvement and campaign completion through the applicable authorized service system.
issues.correction_summary: The February2018 bulletin specifies authorized replacement of driver airbag module assembly39095647.
limits: The stated regions concern current or previous registration, not just present residence.
This implementation document is distinct from the16V-063 Part573 report.
Historical dealer bonus and transportation provisions are not presented as current benefits.
The database is a selected inventory, not a complete or current VIN recall check.
